verdict: above the reporting floor — compression costs 2.5 pp of decision agreement relative to the model's own self-agreement, 95% CI [0.5, 4.5] pp, inside the 5% certified budget
honest_scope: Every replay ran HOT (0 of 399 pinned to temperature 0): Claude Code runs extended thinking by default and Opus 4.7+ removed the temperature knob, so neither arm is greedy. The A/A control is what absorbs that noise, and it is why the raw agreement reads 53% while the paired difference reads 2.5 pp.
The paired difference is the estimator; the raw agreement rates are reported only so the noise floor is visible. The v4 ratio this replaces could not express harm at all.
